newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to answer EU expansion report in September.
newsitem.headline: Poland to answer EU expansion report in September.

text.p: Poland will give an official response in September to a European Commission document judging its readiness for EU entry, Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz said on Wednesday.

Cimoszewicz also said his government would later this month submit to the Commission corrections to errors found in the European Union's "Agenda 2000" report, a blueprint for its most ambitious expansion to date.
"In September we will answer the document and in August we will send the corrections," Cimoszewicz told a meeting of Poland's European Integration Board (RIE).
In the near future the government will work on creating a mandate for Polish negotiators in EU entry talks, he added.
Some RIE members criticised the EU document, saying it was riddled with mistakes, while others said the report showed Poland still had a long way to go before it would be ready for EU membership.

Last month the EU's executive Commission unveiled its Agenda 2000 report, which recommended Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovenia and Estonia, along with Cyprus, should begin EU membership talks next year.
